question: compare average monthly attendance percentage per centre across the two years, one row per centre with both years
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_rate_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_rate_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre ORDER BY centre

WITH combined AS (
  SELECT "Centre" AS centre_name, "Month" AS month, "Enrolled Kids" AS enrolment, "Avg Daily Present" AS average_attendance, 2023 AS year
  FROM "attendance_2023"
  UNION ALL
  SELECT "centre_name", "month", "enrolment", "average_attendance", 2024 AS year
  FROM "attendance_2024"
),
yearly_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    centre_name,
    year,
    SUM(average_attendance) AS total_present,
    SUM(enrolment) AS total_enrolled
  FROM combined
  GROUP BY centre_name, year
)
SELECT 
  centre_name,
  (total_present * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_enrolled, 0)) AS "2023_percentage",
  (total_present * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_enrolled, 0)) AS "2024_percentage"
FROM (
  SELECT 
    centre_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN total_present ELSE 0 END) AS total_present_2023,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN total_enrolled ELSE 0 END) AS total_enrolled_2023,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN total_present ELSE 0 END) AS total_present_2024,
    SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN total_enrolled ELSE 0 END) AS total_enrolled_2024
  FROM yearly_stats
  GROUP BY centre_name
)
